reason: Sachets I can toss in a bag for work trips and the lab report behind the QR code makes it feel less sketchy than most TikTok Shop stuff. $24.99 for the first box is an easy impulse buy and the money-back thing means I'm not stuck.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? Magnesium might do nothing for my sleep and I'd have spent a month on it.
would_change_my_mind: A creator I trust showing real results after a few weeks, or the launch price going away and it being full $29.99 with no discount.
